question: Pandit Shambhu Maharaj, a classical ______ dancer, was awarded Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1967.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kathak.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Shambhu Maharaj was a classical Kathak dancer who was awarded **Sangeet Natak Akademi in 1967.**
 
• Pandit Shambhu Maharaj was a Guru of the Lucknow Gharana (school) of the Indian classical dance form, **Kathak**. 
 
• The world-famous **Kathak dancer, Pandit Birju Maharaj **is the** face of the Kalka-Bindadin gharana** of Lucknow. 
 
• **Kathak, a north Indian dance form,** is a mixture of dance and drama which is usually performed by both men and women.
 
• He was the youngest son of **Kalka Prasad Maharaj **who was at the court of the **Nawab of Awadh Wajid Ali Shah**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shobha** was among the greatest performers of her generation and one of the best exponents of the Kuchipudi art form. 
 
• Shobha was also a dedicated teacher and strove to spread the chaste values of classical dance among her students.
 
• **Mayadhar Raut****,** is known as the exponent of the Indian classical dance form Odissi.
